# Change channel when unheard

`customer_support.pb.de_escalation.change_channel_when_unheard` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When the grievance is about not being heard, move to a channel with a voice in it.

Text strips the signals that prove listening happened, and a long written apology can read as a longer defence. A short call does in minutes what a thread will not do at all — but only when the grievance is about being unheard, not when it is about a missing fix.
